cleansingStrength.rationale: Low: C6 chassis without a prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the nonionic Decyl Glucoside (2), followed by mild anionics Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate (3) and Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate (4). E3 point = Parfum (7). PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate (5) is a thickener (C3, not a route). Counter-signal toward moderate: two anionic co-surfactants and no refatting/conditioning buffer; confidence moderate, neighbor moderate (N-ALT).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led; the only conditioning route is one late cationic starch polymer, Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride (11, after Parfum and preservatives). No silicone, lipid, pearlizer or protein.

depositionLoad.rationale: One late, light cationic starch polymer; nothing else deposits.

persistence.rationale: Single light polysaccharide polymer, no silicone/lipid to retain or accumulate.

resetCapacity.rationale: Three mild surfactants, no refatting load to offset; adequate rinse for the light deposit.

weightPotential.counterEvidence: Recognition of the starch polymer as cationic conditioning (6.4) removes the only gap; no counter-evidence toward moderate beyond its presence.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Deposition is light and low-persistence; the architecture does not support noticeable loss of movement or lift.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: a single deposition family (one late cationic starch polymer) with no reinforcing route, facing mild-but-unopposed reset; W2 permits low for a single light family.
weightPotential.limitingFactor: None material; reasonable unknowns (polymer charge density) would not move the band.
weightPotential.rationale: Low (depositionLoad light, persistence low, resetCapacity moderate).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: explicit sensitive positioning 'für empfindliche Kopfhaut' (manufacturer, moderate; SC1) with a credible supportive architecture: low-strength glucoside/mild-anionic chassis, acidic pH (lactic/citric), sodium lactate humectant, short formula. Counter-signals: Parfum (7), no listed comfort active. Brand-level barrier claims ('Die sebamed ... Produkte') and 'hautverträglich'/'dermatologisch getestet' are not counted (E1, SC1).

primary.rationale: S-ORDINARY way 4: the sensitive target failed its S-SENSITIVE formula gate (scalpComfortTarget targeted, but no prominent E4 comfort route: none of Panthenol, Allantoin, Bisabolol, Urea, Polidocanol, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Avena Sativa, Niacinamide is present). Positioning gate passed (moderate). No other specialist target claimed. S-FAIL -> ordinary proposed with review flag.

cleansingIntensityDetail.rationale: I1 low -> gentle. Bucket normal expects regular -> amber (I2, truthful). I3: current gentle already differs from expected regular -> no flag even though neighbor (moderate -> regular) would match.

reviewFlags.detail: target sensitive; formula gate failed: scalpComfortTarget targeted but no prominent E4 comfort route (S-SENSITIVE). No unlisted prominent comfort candidate (Propylene Glycol (6) is a solvent/humectant, not a comfort route).

uncertainties: S-FOCUS: focusPrimary scalp_active with ordinary target is explained by the S-FAIL flag, so no review_focus_target_mismatch (13.5 third bullet).

Whether a mild acidic glucoside chassis without a listed comfort active is a 'credible supportive architecture' for targeted (§10) is a judgment; if not_targeted, focus would fall to general and the S-FAIL flag would still be raised (positioning claim exists).
